## 中文原文

周五下班之后，你感觉很累。回到家，你简单煮了一碗面条当晚饭。吃完之后，你不想做任何家务，就躺在沙发上刷手机，看短视频放松自己。不知不觉时间过得很快，等你反应过来，已经快半夜了。

## My translation

I felt exhausted after getting off from work on Friday. When I arrived home, I simply made myself a bowl of noodles as dinner. After dinner, I don't want to do any houseworks, so I laid on the sofa scorlling my phone, and watched short videos to relax myself. Time went really fast, when I realized, it is almost midnight.

## Revised version

I was worn out after getting off work on Friday. Once I got home, I quickly whipped up a bowl of noodles for dinner. After eating, I didn’t feel like doing any housework, so I lay on the sofa scrolling on my phone and watching short videos to unwind. Time flew by, and before I knew it, it was nearly midnight.

## Key phrases

- **be worn out**：疲惫不堪（日常口语，替换 *felt exhausted*，更生活化）
- **whip up**：快速简单做（饭菜），很适合描述随便煮一碗面
- **didn’t feel like doing**：不想做……，比 *didn't want to* 更贴合偷懒不想干活的心态
- **scroll on my phone**：刷手机的固定搭配
- **unwind**：放松、解压（替代 *relax*，日常高频）
- **Time flew by**：时光飞逝，比 *time went really fast* 地道很多
- **before I knew it**：不知不觉、转瞬之间，对应“不知不觉，等反应过来”
